title: AXE: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2611.30511v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This report presents a comprehensive pipeline for developing an end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving model for the Physical AI AV Track. The framework consists of data curation, HD map auto-labelling, data-driven imitation learning, and simulator-based reinforcement learning. To ensure safety in the closed-loop setting, we introduce a selection-based E2E planning approach that leverages object detection and BEV segmentation to filter out trajectory candidates likely to cause collisions or off-road driving. Trained on NVIDIA NuRec and the NVIDIA PAI-AV dataset, our method scores a fixed vocabulary of trajectory candidates for collision, drivable-area compliance, and progress learned from simulated rollouts, and selects the best candidate that passes the filter. This design highlights the effectiveness of combining E2E planning with perception-based trajectory filtering for safe and reliable closed-loop autonomous driving.

translated_title: AXE：AlpaSim 端到端闭环挑战技术报告
translated_abstract: 本报告提出了一个面向物理智能自动驾驶赛道的端到端（E2E）自动驾驶模型开发的完整流程。该框架包括数据整理、高精地图自动标注、数据驱动的模仿学习以及基于模拟器的强化学习。为确保闭环环境下的安全性，我们提出了一种基于选择的端到端规划方法，利用目标检测和鸟瞰图（BEV）分割来过滤掉可能导致碰撞或驶出道路的轨迹候选。该方法在NVIDIA NuRec和NVIDIA PAI-AV数据集上进行训练，通过从模拟仿真轨迹中学习，对一组固定的候选轨迹在碰撞风险、可行驶区域合规性和行驶进度方面进行评分，并选出通过过滤器检查的最佳候选轨迹。这一设计凸显了将端到端规划与基于感知的轨迹过滤相结合，对于实现安全可靠的闭环自动驾驶的有效性。
tldr: AXE框架将端到端规划与基于目标检测和BEV分割的轨迹过滤相结合，通过模仿学习与模拟器强化学习训练，对候选轨迹进行安全性和合规性评分并选出最优方案，实现安全可靠的闭环自动驾驶。
en_tdlr: AXE combines end-to-end planning with perception-based trajectory filtering using object detection and BEV segmentation, scoring candidate trajectories for collision, drivable-area compliance, and progress to select the safest option for reliable closed-loop autonomous driving.
